upstream.description: OpenClaw API Directory: 10,000+ APIs organized for OpenClaw. Maintained by The Operator Vault.

classification.analysis: openclaw-api-list is a curated directory of over 10,000 third-party APIs organized into category folders (agents, AI, automation, developer tools, ecommerce, lead-generation, MCP servers, social media, etc.), each with its own README, purpose-built for wiring integrations into the OpenClaw agent framework. It includes scripts for fetching Apify actors and generating the README indexes, plus a promotional 'Operator Vault' membership page, suggesting it's maintained as a lead-gen/reference resource rather than an actively curated community list. Useful mainly as a browsable catalog of connector candidates for OpenClaw-based automations; it has seen no updates since shortly after creation.

use_cases.title: Find a third-party API to wire into an OpenClaw automation
Browse MCP server APIs organized by category
Locate lead-generation or ecommerce APIs for an integration
